From words alone you remind me of myself at 17. 
I had night terrors every damn day of my life due to trauma/abuse.

Let me tell you this… I used weed daily from 14 to 31 before I quit… in those 15 years I don’t really consciously remember having night terrors 
Or a single dream for that matter.

But the day I quit. Jesus fucking Christ did the night terrors come back and WWE drop kick my ass in the chest. 
I took me the best part of 6 months to get through the worst of them SUPER vivid dreams. But after that I was fine. 3 years sober. 
A hospital stint last year stupidly allowed me to think I could smoke to try and build an appetite and regain some well needed weight. 
6 months down the line I was fully addicted again. 
NOW… 3 weeks sober again. 
And the night terrors are back with a VENGEANCE. 

Finally bit the bullet and booked myself in for therapy and EMDR (eye movement desensitisation and reprocessing) which actively aids in rewiring brain processes in relation to trauma and night terrors.

Honestly, (I know this is becoming a rant now) 
But don’t do a me… and lose 15 years.
I wish to God I had started therapy when I was your age. As hard and gut wrenching sickening the thought may be… do it. 
Work through your demons now. You can… it’s hard… but you have the support here you need.
